## 3. Fonts embedded in the web UI

`vite build` copies `ui/public/fonts/` into the embedded UI (`ui/dist/fonts/`, byte-identical
to the source directory). Files found:

| Family | `.woff2` files | Licence | Licence file in this tree |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IBM Plex Sans | 6 | SIL OFL 1.1 | none — see note below |
| IBM Plex Mono | 15 | SIL OFL 1.1 | none — see note below |
| Press Start 2P | 5 | SIL OFL 1.1 | `ui/public/fonts/OFL.txt` |
| Geist | 5 | SIL OFL 1.1 | `ui/public/fonts/geist/OFL.txt` |
| Geist Mono | 6 | SIL OFL 1.1 | `ui/public/fonts/geist/OFL.txt` |

### IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono

Attribution, from `ui/public/fonts/ATTRIBUTION.md`:

> **IBM Plex Sans** and **IBM Plex Mono** — Copyright © 2017 IBM Corp., with
> Reserved Font Names "IBM Plex". Licensed under the **SIL Open Font License,
> Version 1.1**: <https://scripts.sil.org/OFL>

licence text is reproduced verbatim below from the two OFL files in the tree; the
licence is the same document for every family, and only the copyright line above
differs. `ui/public/fonts/ATTRIBUTION.md` records as an open item that the
verbatim upstream IBM Plex licence file is not yet checked in, and this section
does not substitute for it.

## 4. First-party code vendored in this tree

`crates/sigstore` is a pinned copy of the Sigstore keyless-signing and offline-verification
crate (`thruline-sigstore`) from RAAS Labs' own separate repository (source commit
`196d512`; `crates/sigstore/VENDORED.md`). It is first-party code, not
third-party: its `Cargo.toml` reads `license.workspace = true` and `publish = false`, so it takes the
workspace licence (`license = "FSL-1.1-MIT"`) and is excluded from section 1. Its own third-party
crate dependencies are included in section 1. The tree contains no licence or
notice file of any other party; its `fixtures/` are recorded public Sigstore
responses and certificates used by tests, and are not part of the binary.
